notes.title: Pre-Release Log #2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43214756/222f47975d9e1a11a556986383fee1a59bfabedb.png

Hey yall! Basil here again for another juicy Pre-Release Log for H3X@G0N@L. If any of you have read the Discord announcement (you should totally join it), then this should be known news already.

Let's start off with an update to the Building system in the game. The Building Integration system has been updated to allow for much easier creation, connection, and testing of the essential buildings available in the game.

Another good bit of news is that we have created more dynamic gameplay interactions. This allows for more interactive and engaging mechanics that are sure to entice our testers and, eventually, you guys!


Again, if you want to know the full update list, pleasure join our Discord server to get announcements as soon as they come out! This is just a highlight of the more important updates we are making to improve and evolve our game.


That should be all for now! Merry Christmas, and a happy New Year to all of our fans!

- Basil

notes.title: Pre-Release Log #1
notes.notes:
Heyo! This is Basil here from ManoVersa Studios to give you our first ever Pre-Release Log regarding the still-in-development H3X@G0N@L game.

I am happy to announce that development of the game is entering its final stage, and we might have a possible release date. Please do note that it can be subject to change as our developers work hard to finish creating the game.

As of today, we can project a possible release date of Summer 2025. We can also project that it could be as early as June, but it remains subject to change.

That's all for now! I hope this brings you some insight on our current efforts. In the meantime, have a smiling cable (:
